Both are project-based construction service providers that sell to builders and developers in residential and commercial construction. The offerings differ. The target is a niche specialist in operated concrete pumping and placement, plus concrete waste management. The comp self-performs civil site work (grading, utilities, drilling and blasting, asphalt paving) in the Southeast and makes its own asphalt. The comp's customers include developers and municipalities, so the customer overlap is only partial. The target also operates in the U.S. and U.K., while the comp is regional.

P1.2.text: Concrete Pumping Holdings is the leading provider of concrete pumping services and concrete waste management solutions in the U.S. and U.K., operating under the only established, national brands in both countries.

P1.3.text: Concrete Pumping Holdings is the leading provider of concrete pumping services in the highly fragmented U.S. and U.K. markets, operating under the only established, national brands in both markets (Brundage-Bone and Camfaud, respectively). Concrete pumping is a "mission-critical" method of concrete placement that requires highly-skilled operators to position a truck-mounted fully-articulating boom for precise delivery of ready-mix concrete from mixer trucks to placing crews on a job site. CPH's large fleet of specialized pumping equipment and highly-trained operators position CPH to deliver concrete placement solutions that facilitate substantial labor cost savings to customers, shorten concrete placement times, enhance worksite safety and improve construction quality. CPH operates a fee-based revenue model with no bonding requirements.

P1.4.text: CPH is also the leading provider of concrete waste management services in the U.S. market, operating under the only established, national brand, Eco-Pan. Highly complementary to its core concrete pumping service, Eco-Pan provides a full-service, cost-effective, regulatory-compliant solution to manage environmental issues caused by concrete washout.

P1.5.text: As of, the Company provided concrete pumping services in the U.S. from a footprint of multiple branch locations across approximately 20 states, concrete pumping services in the U.K. from multiple branch locations, and route-based concrete waste management services from multiple operating locations in the U.S. and 1 shared location in the U.K.

P1.6.text: For more information, please visit www.concretepumpingholdings.com or the Company’s brand websites at www.brundagebone.com, www.camfaud.co.uk, or www.eco-pan.com.

P1.8.text: Brundage-Bone is the largest concrete pumping and material placement service provider in the United States.

P1.10.text: Capital Pumping is a leading provider of concrete pumping services in Texas.

P1.12.text: Camfaud is the largest concrete pumping and material placement service provider in the United Kingdom.

P1.14.text: Eco-Pan is the leading provider of environmental waste management services to the concrete industry in the United States. We specialize in concrete cleanup and disposal services across the country.

P1.15.text: Our team has extensive expertise in providing top-notch concrete pumping service in the U.S. under the Brundage-Bone brand, concrete pumping service in the U.K. under the Camfaud brand, and concrete waste management services in the U.S. under the Eco-Pan brand.

P2.1.text: U.K. Concrete Pumping - Camfaud :: Concrete Pumping Holdings, Inc.

P2.2.text: Camfaud is the largest concrete pumping company in the U.K. As of, the Company provides concrete pumping services from multiple locations throughout the U.K., offering the largest, most diverse fleet in the country.

P3.1.text: U.S. Concrete Pumping - Brundage-Bone :: Concrete Pumping Holdings, Inc.

P3.2.text: Brundage-Bone is the largest concrete pumping and material placement service in the United States. with just one location in Denver, Colorado, Brundage-Bone provides concrete pumping services in the U.S. with a fleet of 482 equipment units from a highly diversified footprint of multiple locations across 22 states (as of). Since our origin we have more experience pumping concrete than anyone. Brundage-Bone supplies the largest and most diverse fleet of concrete pumping vehicles and equipment with the most multi-regional locations across the nation. Due to our vast knowledge of concrete pumping, we continue to lead the industry in technology, customer service, fleet and location size, training, and safety.

P1.1.text: Cardinal Infrastructure Group | Cardinal Infrastructure Group

P1.2.text: Cardinal Infrastructure Group is a civil infrastructure and site development services provider operating in the Southeast that is delivering integrity from the ground up.

P1.3.text: Civil Infrastructure Services, Delivering Integrity from the Ground Up

P1.4.text: Across the Southeast, the neighborhoods, commercial developments, roads and other infrastructure taking shape all start in the same place: the ground. Cardinal Infrastructure Group is a vertically integrated civil infrastructure and site development platform serving residential, commercial, industrial and municipal projects.

P1.5.text: Our operating companies self-perform site work from preconstruction to paving, including grading, site clearing, erosion control, underground utilities, drilling and blasting, and asphalt paving. Bringing multiple phases of the work under one accountable team gives our clients a single point of responsibility across the site.

P1.6.text: Every decision is guided by doing what's right and what creates long-term value for everyone.

P1.7.text: Site development across multiple phases, under one accountable team.

P1.8.text: Local expertise. Shared standards. One Cardinal.

P1.9.text: Vertically integrated. Disciplined acquirer. Founder led.

P1.10.text: The strongest relationships we build are inside our company. At Cardinal, we hire the right people and trust them to uphold our standards.

P1.11.text: One company, with crews, equipment and expertise across the Southeast.

P2.1.text: Civil Construction Services | Cardinal Infrastructure Group

P2.2.text: Cardinal Infrastructure Group delivers end to end civil construction and site development through a vertically integrated, self performing platform.

P2.4.text: and led by executives with more than 30 years in the field, we know the value of relationships. We've built our reputation on delivering for everyone who works with us. At Cardinal, we plan carefully, communicate early, and work to the agreed on schedule and specifications. Partners run their businesses to take advantage of the opportunities in front of them. Employees know they can make the right call so that work moves forward safely. We show up, communicate clearly and deliver on what we promise.

P2.5.text: And we grow with the same intent, by doing work right the first time and acquiring companies whose people and standards match our own. That foundation guides every decision we make. It's how we deliver Integrity from the Ground Up.

P2.7.text: Bringing multiple phases under one team means one point of accountability for the site, and fewer gaps between phases. Our team is responsible for the scope, and you get work done to our standards and results we answer for directly.

P2.8.text: With work sequenced in-house, we anticipate what's next and keep work moving. Having access to the crews, equipment and resources to keep your project moving helps us deliver on tight schedules.

P2.9.text: Being a partner starts before the work does. We plan scope, schedules and budgets with you before crews mobilize. From preconstruction through closeout we stay close, communicate early and honestly, and bring solutions.

P2.10.text: Safety is a commitment we make to each other and to the communities where we build, backed by ongoing training and a dedicated safety team. It's a standard we hold every day, on every site.

P2.11.text: We're growing across the Southeast and adding crews in every market we serve.

P2.12.text: We pursue acquisitions that expand our geographic footprint or build density in our existing markets. Cultural fit is one of the main the deciding factors. We integrate companies whose people share our same standards, take care of their teams and want to keep building with us.

P2.14.text: Every capability we've brought in-house traces back to one idea: control the work and you control the outcome.
